config.crystalix.disabled_properties.too:
§8Wand properties that can't be changed on a wand. Only operators can apply them to blocks.§r
§8Valid values: apply_mode, invisible, light, ghost, color, material, shadeless, tinted, reinforced, waterloggable, conductor, redstone§r

§7Default: []§r
§8The radius in chunks around the player that should be highlighted§r

§7Default: 6§r
config.crystalix.jade_mode.tooltip:
§8Decides when Jade should be displayed§r

§7§lALWAYS§r§7: Always show Jade§r
§7§lWAND§r§7: Only show Jade while holding a wand§r
§7§lNEVER§r§7: Never show Jade§r
§7Default: WAND§r
config.crystalix.max_block_edits.tooltip:
§8After how many the multi-block edit mode of the wand should stop.§r
§8This has no effect on performance, but you might want to limit it anyways.§r

§7Default: 262144§r
config.crystalix.max_block_edits_per_tic:
§8The maximum number of blocks that can be modified in a single tick by multi-block edit.§r
§8If you're experiencing performance issues you might want to lower this number.§r

§7Default: 256§r
config.crystalix.show_wand_tooltips.tool:
§8Show property tooltips on the wand§r

§7Default: true§r
tooltip.crystalix.apply_mode.colorless: Applies all properties except for the color
tooltip.crystalix.apply_mode.exact: When bulk applying properties, only exact matches to the initial block will be edited
tooltip.crystalix.color: Changes the color of the glass
tooltip.crystalix.colorless: %s to toggle applying properties with or without color
tooltip.crystalix.conductor.off: Prevents redstone signals from passing through this block
tooltip.crystalix.conductor.on: Allows redstones signals to pass through this block
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.all: Allows any entities to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.allow_adult: Allows adult entities to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.block_adult: Allows any entities which aren't adults to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.block_animal: Allows any entities but animals to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.block_monster: Allows any entities but monsters to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.block_player: Allows any entities but players to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.ghost.none: Allows no entities to pass through
tooltip.crystalix.highlight: %s to highlight all crystalix blocks in your surroundings
tooltip.crystalix.light.dark: Blocks surrounding light from passing through
tooltip.crystalix.light.fake_dark: Does not render light while maintaining a real impact, such as blocking mob spawns
tooltip.crystalix.light.fake_light: Renders light without any real impact, such as blocking mob spawns
tooltip.crystalix.material.bordered: Normal glass texture but without the specs on the glass
tooltip.crystalix.property_pick: %s to pick properties from a block
tooltip.crystalix.redstone: Emits a redstone signal at the given level
tooltip.crystalix.reinforced.off: Makes the glass to be broken as normal
tooltip.crystalix.reinforced.on: Makes the glass indestructible to anything but players and increases breaking duration
tooltip.crystalix.shadeless.on: Will not render any shadows on the block
tooltip.crystalix.show_properties: To show currently selected properties in the tooltip toggle the config
tooltip.crystalix.tinted.off: Uses the non-tinted texture variant while still applying the selected tint
tooltip.crystalix.tinted.on: Uses the fully tinted texture variant
tooltip.crystalix.use_wand: To modify block properties and access different texture or colors use the Crystalix Wand
tooltip.crystalix.waterloggable.off: Prevents the glass from changing its waterlogged state
tooltip.crystalix.waterloggable.on: Allows the glass to change its waterlogged state
